videos.title: Folding Pass by Kaynan Duarte
videos.whyUseful: ADCC gold medalist Kaynan Duarte demonstrates the folding pass mechanics in detail — establishing the tripod base, driving head pressure into the far hip, and folding the opponent's body to flatten their guard. An authoritative primary reference from one of the best pressure passers in no-gi.

videos.title: Nogi Folding Pass from Headquarters
videos.whyUseful: Instructor Jose Portillo Jr. demonstrates the folding pass specifically from the headquarters position — covering the tripod base, shoulder pressure, and how to fold the opponent's legs to flatten their guard. Directly matches the technique description.

videos.title: Passing Half-Guard to Armlock and Triangle: Tripod Method
videos.whyUseful: John Danaher himself teaches the Tripod Method for passing the half-guard — establishing the tripod base, controlling the near hip, and folding the opponent's legs to flatten them before transitioning to armlocks or triangles. An authoritative primary reference from the creator of modern no-gi pressure passing.

videos.title: Gordon Ryan Guard Pass Study Part 14 — Entering from De La Riva
videos.whyUseful: Study of Gordon Ryan's passing system from the headquarters position, covering the folding and smash pass mechanics that define his approach. Useful for understanding how elite no-gi competitors chain the tripod/folding pass with other passing options.
